2026 Sample Grand Prix, Race (R), 2026-03-08, Synthetic Circuit: 20 laps.
Won by AAA (Sample Racing) by 11.700 s from BBB, as timed.

Pit stops and tyres (S soft, M medium, H hard, I intermediate, W wet): AAA 1 (lap 9; S-H), BBB 2 (laps 6, 12; S-M-S), CCC 0 (H), DDD 0 (M).
Fastest lap: AAA 1:29.500 (lap 18).
Grid positions, penalties, the official classification and retirement reasons aren't in the processed data: the order is as timed on track and positions start at the end of lap 1.
